Question 1
?

(x+2y)8=

a
x8+8x7y+24x6y2+…
b
x8+8x7y+112x6y2+…
c
x8+16x7y+1024x6y2+…
d
x8+16x7y+108x6y2+…
e
x8+16x7y+112x6y2+…
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

The binomial theorem states that for any positive integer n, we have

(a+b)n=(n0)anb0+(n1)an−1b1+(n2)an−2b2+…+(nn)a0bn.

In the case of (x+2y)8, we have a=x, b=2y, n=8.

Therefore, the first three terms of (x+2y)8 are as follows:

(x+2y)8=(80)(x)8(2y)0+(81)(x)8−1(2y)1+(82)(x)8−2(2y)2+…=1(x)8+8(x)7(2y)1+28(x)6(2y)2+…=x8+16x7y1+28x6(4y2)+…=x8+16x7y+112x6y2+…
